rubric.role_summary: Full-cycle Account Executive selling fund administration and software solutions to private equity real estate and real assets investment managers, with responsibility for new business and account growth.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Full-cycle Account Executive selling fund administration and software solutions to private equity real estate and real assets investment managers, with responsibility for new business and account growth.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of B2B, full-cycle, quota-carrying sales experience.
- Experience selling fund administration services, FinTech solutions, SaaS products, or comparable offerings.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Knowledge of or experience within the CRE ecosystem.
- Proficiency with sales tools; Salesforce, Outreach, and Gong are examples, not individually required tools.
- Project management skills involving leading and coordinating across multiple stakeholders.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California; USA; Canada. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.

source_quotes: Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices.
We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

soft_requirements: Curiosity and eagerness to understand the market and customer needs.
Integrity, ethics, and alignment with company values.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including comfort presenting to different audiences.
Ability to prioritize outcomes that deliver commercial success and customer value.
